profileEvidence.author: B
profileEvidence.summary: Curious, cheerful and sociable, the Petit Basset Griffon Vendéen likes company while keeping a mind of its own. It can enjoy learning and attention, yet an enticing scent may redirect its plans. Developed for small-game hunting in the rough Vendée countryside, this bold hound is especially associated with rabbits and bramble cover, and freely uses its voice.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A cheerful, curious French hound with a social nature, an independent streak and strong scent-driven rabbit-hunting roots.
